snippet.title: Chaotic Co-Op Survival in Space - Space Gnomes Pre-Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
Space Gnomes annnouncing Pre-Alpha 🚀
Wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4625180/Space_Gnomes/
Check out also Brew & Defend: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4968510/BrewDefend/

A chaotic multiplayer co-op survival adventure where brave space gnomes battle an invading empire of galactic garden moles determined to conquer the universe.

Explore procedurally generated planets, scavenge valuable resources, craft powerful weapons, and survive against dangerous alien creatures lurking in the dark. Work together with your team using proximity voice chat, revive fallen allies, and try not to panic when the space wasps arrive.

Wishlist Space Gnomes and prepare for absolute galactic chaos.

Did we mention Gnomes?
